featured_reviews.name: Paresh Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Gokulam Pharmacy near CP Tank today (15/05/2026) to buy Zocef 500. Total bill was ₹549.39 and after only 15% discount I paid around ₹467 online.

Issue was not even the amount, but the handling. Most medical stores nearby usually give 20% discount on this medicine, so within 1 minute of payment (while still standing at the counter) I requested either matching discount or full refund and return of medicine. Instead, I was told refund is not possible and only store credit can be given.

Customer should at least have flexibility for immediate cancellation when product has not even left the store. Felt disappointing honestly.

Not writing this to fight with anyone, but management should improve customer handling and pricing consistency because nearby chemists are offering better discounts and smoother service. Hope they improve.
⭐ 1/5
